HERO SYNDROME STEAM GAMES FESTIVAL DEVELOPER Q&A


Come join in and ask me anything about development or the game!

As a solo developer I appreciate all of the support you all have shown!! Thank you.
(Wishlisting also very much appreciated!)

Hero Syndrome is a third-person shooter puzzle game with dynamic combat and an intricate building system. The play through session will showcase the single player demo.

Join the Hero Syndrome Discord for the latest updates: https://discord.gg/nTR4U4H

HERO SYNDROME STEAM GAMES FESTIVAL LIVE STREAM


Join me as I play through the Hero Syndrome alpha demo.  I'll talk about what the future holds for the Hero Syndrome campaign and also what's in the works for online multiplayer.


Hero Syndrome is a third-person shooter puzzle game with dynamic combat and an intricate building system. The play through session will showcase the single player demo.
